heroDescription: Comprehensive lessons covering Python fundamentals, advanced concepts, and real-world projects

variables-datatypes.title: Variables, Data Types & Operators
variables-datatypes.description: Learn the fundamentals of Python programming including how to store data in variables, work with different data types, and perform operations.

control-structures.title: Control Structures
control-structures.description: Master decision-making and repetition in Python with if/else statements, for loops, while loops, and conditional logic.

functions.title: Functions & Basic Error Handling
functions.description: Create reusable code with functions, understand parameters and return values, and handle errors gracefully.

string-manipulation.title: String Manipulation & Formatting
string-manipulation.description: Work with text data effectively using string methods, formatting techniques, and text processing operations.

data-structures.title: Data Structures
data-structures.description: Explore Python's built-in data structures: lists, dictionaries, sets, and tuples for efficient data organization.

oop.title: Object-Oriented Programming
oop.description: Learn to create classes and objects, understand inheritance, encapsulation, and polymorphism in Python.

file-handling.title: File Handling & I/O Operations
file-handling.description: Read from and write to files, work with different file formats, and handle file system operations.

modules.title: Modules & Package Management
modules.description: Organize code with modules, import external libraries, and manage dependencies with pip.

api-integration.title: API Integration & Web Requests
api-integration.description: Connect to web APIs, make HTTP requests, handle JSON data, and integrate external services.

database-operations.title: Database Operations & SQL
database-operations.description: Work with databases using Python, execute SQL queries, and manage data persistence.

decorators.title: Decorators & Context Managers
decorators.description: Master advanced Python features like decorators for code enhancement and context managers for resource handling.

testing-debugging.title: Testing & Debugging Techniques
testing-debugging.description: Write reliable code with unit tests, debug effectively, and ensure code quality.

web-scraping.title: Web Scraping Application
web-scraping.description: Build a complete web scraping application to extract data from websites using BeautifulSoup and requests.

data-analysis.title: Data Analysis Dashboard
data-analysis.description: Create an interactive data analysis dashboard using pandas, matplotlib, and other data science libraries.

rest-api.title: REST API Development
rest-api.description: Develop a full-featured REST API with Flask or FastAPI, including authentication and database integration.

machine-learning.title: Machine Learning Project
machine-learning.description: Build a machine learning model from data preprocessing to deployment using scikit-learn.

learningJourney.title: Your Learning Journey
learningJourney.subtitle: Follow our structured path from beginner to expert, with hands-on projects to solidify your skills
learningJourney.foundationDesc: Master the basics of Python programming
learningJourney.intermediateDesc: Explore data structures and OOP concepts
learningJourney.advancedDesc: Dive into APIs, databases, and testing
